verdict.rationale: Fly.io's docs describe installing flyctl and running `fly launch` to deploy directly from the CLI, with a dedicated flyctl reference at fly.io/docs/flyctl/, confirming CLI-first deploy workflow without needing a dashboard. Community evidence (mixed reliability complaints) doesn't dispute the CLI deploy capability itself. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a fully dashboard-free workflow and more detail on CLI deploy edge cases.
